comparison.objective: Level a production mix in a heijunka box, rather than mechanically finish inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Card/item redistribution and production-sequence balancing versus precision mandrel insertion, hammer impact, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies a leveled production mix; body names the task but provides no leveling metric or rubric. It does not require physical fracture or retained-coil protection.
comparison.reason: Production-mix balancing is a different planning and placement ability.
